#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const int MOD = 1000000007;

struct Factor {
    int a, b, p; // p * x^a + (1-p) * x^b
};

long long floor_div(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a >= 0) return a / b;
    return - ((-a + b - 1) / b);
}

int mod_pos(long long a, long long b) {
    int r = (int)(a % b);
    if (r < 0) r += (int)b;
    return r;
}

struct Solver {
    int N, M;
    long long K;

    vector<int> p, q, x;
    vector<int> rp, rm, basep, basem;

    vector<int> positions;
    int Q;

    vector<vector<int>> special;
    vector<vector<Factor>> seg;
    vector<int> diff, offsetAt, ans;
    vector<int> tempArr;

    void addFactor(int idx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, const Factor& f) {
        if (ql >= r || qr <= l) return;
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
            seg[idx].push_back(f);
            return;
        }
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        addFactor(idx << 1, l, m, ql, qr, f);
        addFactor(idx << 1 | 1, m, r, ql, qr, f);
    }

    void applyFactor(vector<int>& cur, const Factor& f) {
        int a = f.a, b = f.b, pj = f.p;
        int *c = cur.data();
        int *t = tempArr.data();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int i1 = i - a;
            if (i1 < 0) i1 += N;
            int i2 = i - b;
            if (i2 < 0) i2 += N;

            int d = c[i1] - c[i2];
            if (d < 0) d += MOD;

            long long v = (long long)pj * d % MOD;
            int res = c[i2] + (int)v;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            t[i] = res;
        }
        cur.swap(tempArr);
    }

    void processLeaf(int idx, vector<int>& cur) {
        int posi = positions[idx];
        auto& vec = special[idx];
        int s = (int)vec.size();
        int masks = 1 << s;
        int offset = offsetAt[idx];

        long long resAns = 0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < masks; mask++) {
            long long prob = 1;
            int E = 0;
            int fixed = 0;

            for (int jj = 0; jj < s; jj++) {
                int cow = vec[jj];
                int res, base;

                if (mask & (1 << jj)) {
                    res = rp[cow];
                    base = basep[cow];
                    prob = prob * p[cow] % MOD;
                } else {
                    res = rm[cow];
                    base = basem[cow];
                    prob = prob * q[cow] % MOD;
                }

                int sub = (res < posi ? 1 : 0);
                int h = base - sub;
                if (h < 0) h += N;

                fixed += h;
                if (fixed >= N) fixed -= N;

                if (res == posi) E++;
            }

            if (prob == 0 || E == 0) continue;

            for (int t = 0; t < E; t++) {
                int sOther = t - fixed;
                sOther %= N;
                if (sOther < 0) sOther += N;

                int qidx = sOther - offset;
                qidx %= N;
                if (qidx < 0) qidx += N;

                long long add = prob * cur[qidx] % MOD;
                resAns += add;
                if (resAns >= MOD) resAns -= MOD;
            }
        }

        ans[posi] = (int)(resAns % MOD);
    }

    void dfs(int idx, int l, int r, vector<int>& cur) {
        vector<int> saved;
        bool needSave = false;

        for (const Factor& f : seg[idx]) {
            if (!needSave) {
                saved = cur;
                needSave = true;
            }
            applyFactor(cur, f);
        }

        if (l + 1 == r) {
            processLeaf(l, cur);
        } else {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            dfs(idx << 1, l, m, cur);
            dfs(idx << 1 | 1, m, r, cur);
        }

        if (needSave) {
            cur = move(saved);
        }
    }

    void solve() {
        cin >> N >> M >> K;

        p.resize(N);
        q.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            cin >> p[i];
            q[i] = 1 - p[i];
            if (q[i] < 0) q[i] += MOD;
        }

        x.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) cin >> x[i];

        rp.resize(N);
        rm.resize(N);
        basep.resize(N);
        basem.resize(N);

        vector<int> allPos;
        allPos.reserve(2 * N);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            long long yp = (long long)x[i] + K;
            long long ym = (long long)x[i] - K;

            int bp = (int)(floor_div(yp, M) % N);
            if (bp < 0) bp += N;
            int bm = (int)(floor_div(ym, M) % N);
            if (bm < 0) bm += N;

            basep[i] = bp;
            basem[i] = bm;

            rp[i] = mod_pos(yp, M);
            rm[i] = mod_pos(ym, M);

            allPos.push_back(rp[i]);
            allPos.push_back(rm[i]);
        }

        sort(allPos.begin(), allPos.end());
        allPos.erase(unique(allPos.begin(), allPos.end()), allPos.end());

        positions = move(allPos);
        Q = (int)positions.size();

        special.assign(Q, {});

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int idx = lower_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rp[i]) - positions.begin();
            special[idx].push_back(i);

            if (rm[i] != rp[i]) {
                idx = lower_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rm[i]) - positions.begin();
                special[idx].push_back(i);
            }
        }

        diff.assign(Q + 1, 0);
        seg.assign(4 * Q + 5, {});
        tempArr.assign(N, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int rpi = rp[i], rmi = rm[i];

            int c1 = upper_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rpi) - positions.begin();
            int c2 = upper_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rmi) - positions.begin();

            int e1 = lower_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rpi) - positions.begin();
            int e2 = lower_bound(positions.begin(), positions.end(), rmi) - positions.begin();

            vector<int> bounds = {0, Q, c1, c2};
            sort(bounds.begin(), bounds.end());
            bounds.erase(unique(bounds.begin(), bounds.end()), bounds.end());

            for (int bi = 0; bi + 1 < (int)bounds.size(); bi++) {
                int L = bounds[bi];
                int R = bounds[bi + 1];
                if (L >= R) continue;

                vector<int> cuts = {L, R};

                if (e1 >= L && e1 < R) {
                    cuts.push_back(e1);
                    cuts.push_back(e1 + 1);
                }
                if (e2 != e1 && e2 >= L && e2 < R) {
                    cuts.push_back(e2);
                    cuts.push_back(e2 + 1);
                }

                sort(cuts.begin(), cuts.end());
                cuts.erase(unique(cuts.begin(), cuts.end()), cuts.end());

                for (int k = 0; k + 1 < (int)cuts.size(); k++) {
                    int l = cuts[k];
                    int r = cuts[k + 1];
                    if (l >= r) continue;

                    if (r - l == 1 && (l == e1 || l == e2)) continue;

                    int hp = basep[i] - (positions[l] > rpi ? 1 : 0);
                    if (hp < 0) hp += N;

                    int hm = basem[i] - (positions[l] > rmi ? 1 : 0);
                    if (hm < 0) hm += N;

                    int pj = p[i];

                    if (pj == 0) {
                        int shift = hm;
                        diff[l] += shift;
                        if (diff[l] >= N) diff[l] -= N;
                        diff[r] -= shift;
                        if (diff[r] < 0) diff[r] += N;
                    } else if (pj == 1) {
                        int shift = hp;
                        diff[l] += shift;
                        if (diff[l] >= N) diff[l] -= N;
                        diff[r] -= shift;
                        if (diff[r] < 0) diff[r] += N;
                    } else if (hp == hm) {
                        int shift = hp;
                        diff[l] += shift;
                        if (diff[l] >= N) diff[l] -= N;
                        diff[r] -= shift;
                        if (diff[r] < 0) diff[r] += N;
                    } else {
                        Factor f{hp, hm, pj};
                        addFactor(1, 0, Q, l, r, f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        offsetAt.assign(Q, 0);
        int curShift = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < Q; i++) {
            curShift += diff[i];
            curShift %= N;
            if (curShift < 0) curShift += N;
            offsetAt[i] = curShift;
        }

        ans.assign(M, 0);

        vector<int> cur(N, 0);
        cur[0] = 1;

        dfs(1, 0, Q, cur);

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            if (i) cout << ' ';
            cout << ans[i];
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T;
    cin >> T;

    while (T--) {
        Solver solver;
        solver.solve();
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static constexpr int MOD = 1'000'000'007;

int addmod(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
    return a;
}

int submod(int a, int b) {
    a -= b;
    if (a < 0) a += MOD;
    return a;
}

int mulmod(int a, int b) {
    return int(1LL * a * b % MOD);
}

int modpow(int a, long long e) {
    int r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = mulmod(r, a);
        a = mulmod(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

struct Cow {
    int x;
    int cw, ccw;
    int invCw, invCc;
};

struct Event {
    int y;
    int type; // 0: clockwise endpoint, 1: counterclockwise endpoint
    int cow;

    bool operator<(const Event& other) const {
        if (y != other.y) return y < other.y;
        return type < other.type;
    }
};

// Multiplies a polynomial A(z) by q + p*z.
vector<int> multiplyFactor(const vector<int>& a, const Cow& c) {
    int n = int(a.size());
    vector<int> result(n + 1, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long value = 0;
        if (i < n) value += 1LL * c.ccw * a[i];
        if (i > 0) value += 1LL * c.cw * a[i - 1];
        result[i] = int(value % MOD);
    }
    return result;
}

// Divides a polynomial known to be divisible by q + p*z.
// The size of a is the conceptual number of factors plus one.
vector<int> divideFactor(const vector<int>& a, const Cow& c) {
    int degree = int(a.size()) - 1;
    vector<int> result(degree, 0);

    if (c.ccw != 0) {
        int previous = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < degree; ++k) {
            int value = submod(a[k], mulmod(c.cw, previous));
            result[k] = mulmod(value, c.invCc);
            previous = result[k];
        }
    } else {
        // q + p*z = p*z because q = 0.
        for (int k = 0; k < degree; ++k) {
            result[k] = mulmod(a[k + 1], c.invCw);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

// Builds A and B such that the cyclic convolution A*B represents
// t * (#CW outside the high set) + (t+1) * (#CW inside the high set).
void buildConvolutionPolynomials(
    const vector<int>& pin,
    const vector<int>& pout,
    int t,
    int n,
    vector<int>& A,
    vector<int>& B
) {
    A.assign(n, 0);
    B.assign(n, 0);

    int tm1 = (t + 1) % n;

    for (int v = 0; v < int(pout.size()); ++v) {
        int index = int(1LL * t * v % n);
        A[index] = addmod(A[index], pout[v]);
    }

    for (int u = 0; u < int(pin.size()); ++u) {
        int index = int(1LL * tm1 * u % n);
        B[index] = addmod(B[index], pin[u]);
    }
}

// Returns selected coefficients of the cyclic convolution A*B.
vector<int> convolutionCoefficients(
    const vector<int>& A,
    const vector<int>& B,
    const vector<int>& targets
) {
    int n = int(A.size());

    vector<pair<int, int>> sa, sb;
    sa.reserve(n);
    sb.reserve(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (A[i] != 0) sa.emplace_back(i, A[i]);
        if (B[i] != 0) sb.emplace_back(i, B[i]);
    }

    vector<int> answer(targets.size(), 0);

    if (sa.size() <= sb.size()) {
        for (auto [index, value] : sa) {
            for (int k = 0; k < int(targets.size()); ++k) {
                int other = targets[k] - index;
                if (other < 0) other += n;
                answer[k] = addmod(
                    answer[k],
                    mulmod(value, B[other])
                );
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (auto [index, value] : sb) {
            for (int k = 0; k < int(targets.size()); ++k) {
                int other = targets[k] - index;
                if (other < 0) other += n;
                answer[k] = addmod(
                    answer[k],
                    mulmod(value, A[other])
                );
            }
        }
    }

    return answer;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T;
    cin >> T;

    while (T--) {
        int N, M;
        long long K;
        cin >> N >> M >> K;

        vector<Cow> cows(N);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            cin >> cows[i].cw;
            cows[i].ccw = (1 - cows[i].cw + MOD) % MOD;

            cows[i].invCw = cows[i].cw == 0 ? 0 : modpow(cows[i].cw, MOD - 2);
            cows[i].invCc = cows[i].ccw == 0 ? 0 : modpow(cows[i].ccw, MOD - 2);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            cin >> cows[i].x;
        }

        long long quotient = K / M;
        int remainder = int(K % M);

        int lowValue = (2LL * remainder >= M ? 1 : 0);
        int t = int((2LL * (quotient % N) + lowValue) % N);

        vector<int> h(N);
        vector<int> high(N, 0);

        int sumB = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            int a = (cows[i].x + remainder) / M;
            int b = (cows[i].x < remainder ? -1 : 0);
            h[i] = a - b;
            sumB += b;
            high[i] = (h[i] == lowValue + 1);
        }

        int bMod = (sumB % N + N) % N;

        auto buildPartition = [&](bool useHigh) {
            vector<int> polynomial(1, 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                if (high[i] == useHigh) {
                    polynomial = multiplyFactor(polynomial, cows[i]);
                }
            }
            return polynomial;
        };

        vector<int> pin = buildPartition(true);
        vector<int> pout = buildPartition(false);

        vector<Event> events;
        events.reserve(2 * N);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            int clockwiseEndpoint = int((cows[i].x + 1LL * remainder) % M);
            int counterclockwiseEndpoint =
                int((cows[i].x - 1LL * remainder + M) % M);

            events.push_back({clockwiseEndpoint, 0, i});
            events.push_back({counterclockwiseEndpoint, 1, i});
        }

        sort(events.begin(), events.end());

        vector<int> answer(M, 0);

        auto removeCow = [&](vector<int>& polynomial, int cow) {
            polynomial = divideFactor(polynomial, cows[cow]);
        };

        auto updateHigh = [&](int cow, bool newHigh) {
            if (high[cow] == newHigh) return;

            if (newHigh) {
                pin = multiplyFactor(pin, cows[cow]);
                pout = divideFactor(pout, cows[cow]);
            } else {
                pin = divideFactor(pin, cows[cow]);
                pout = multiplyFactor(pout, cows[cow]);
            }

            high[cow] = newHigh;
        };

        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < int(events.size())) {
            int end = pos;
            int y = events[pos].y;

            while (end < int(events.size()) && events[end].y == y) {
                ++end;
            }

            int cp = -1; // Unique cow whose clockwise endpoint is y.
            int cm = -1; // Unique cow whose counterclockwise endpoint is y.

            for (int j = pos; j < end; ++j) {
                if (events[j].type == 0) cp = events[j].cow;
                else cm = events[j].cow;
            }

            int s0 = (N - bMod) % N;
            int s1 = (s0 + 1) % N;

            vector<int> A, B;

            if (cp >= 0 && cm >= 0 && cp == cm) {
                // This cow reaches y regardless of its direction.
                vector<int> pinRest = pin;
                vector<int> poutRest = pout;

                if (high[cp]) removeCow(pinRest, cp);
                else removeCow(poutRest, cp);

                buildConvolutionPolynomials(
                    pinRest, poutRest, t, N, A, B
                );

                int shiftClockwise = (t + high[cp]) % N;
                int targetClockwise = (s0 - shiftClockwise + N) % N;

                vector<int> coefficients = convolutionCoefficients(
                    A, B, {targetClockwise, s0}
                );

                int probability = 0;
                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(cows[cp].cw, coefficients[0])
                );
                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(cows[cp].ccw, coefficients[1])
                );

                answer[y] = probability;
            } else if (cp >= 0 && cm >= 0) {
                // Distinct cows can have their endpoints coincide at y.
                vector<int> pinRest = pin;
                vector<int> poutRest = pout;

                if (high[cp]) removeCow(pinRest, cp);
                else removeCow(poutRest, cp);

                if (high[cm]) removeCow(pinRest, cm);
                else removeCow(poutRest, cm);

                buildConvolutionPolynomials(
                    pinRest, poutRest, t, N, A, B
                );

                int zcp = high[cp];
                int zcm = high[cm];

                // Both clockwise: only cp reaches y; D must be 0.
                int shiftBothCW = (2 * t + zcp + zcm) % N;

                // Both counterclockwise: only cm reaches y; D must be 0.
                int shiftBothCCW = 0;

                // cp clockwise and cm counterclockwise: both reach y;
                // D may be 0 or 1.
                int shiftMixed = (t + zcp) % N;

                vector<int> targets = {
                    (s0 - shiftBothCW + N) % N,
                    s0,
                    (s0 - shiftMixed + N) % N,
                    (s1 - shiftMixed + N) % N
                };

                vector<int> coefficients =
                    convolutionCoefficients(A, B, targets);

                int probability = 0;

                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(
                        mulmod(cows[cp].cw, cows[cm].cw),
                        coefficients[0]
                    )
                );

                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(
                        mulmod(cows[cp].ccw, cows[cm].ccw),
                        coefficients[1]
                    )
                );

                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(
                        mulmod(cows[cp].cw, cows[cm].ccw),
                        coefficients[2]
                    )
                );

                probability = addmod(
                    probability,
                    mulmod(
                        mulmod(cows[cp].cw, cows[cm].ccw),
                        coefficients[3]
                    )
                );

                answer[y] = probability;
            } else if (cp >= 0) {
                // Only the clockwise endpoint of cp is y.
                vector<int> pinRest = pin;
                vector<int> poutRest = pout;

                if (high[cp]) removeCow(pinRest, cp);
                else removeCow(poutRest, cp);

                buildConvolutionPolynomials(
                    pinRest, poutRest, t, N, A, B
                );

                int shift = (t + high[cp]) % N;
                int target = (s0 - shift + N) % N;

                vector<int> coefficients =
                    convolutionCoefficients(A, B, {target});

                answer[y] = mulmod(cows[cp].cw, coefficients[0]);
            } else {
                // Only the counterclockwise endpoint of cm is y.
                vector<int> pinRest = pin;
                vector<int> poutRest = pout;

                if (high[cm]) removeCow(pinRest, cm);
                else removeCow(poutRest, cm);

                buildConvolutionPolynomials(
                    pinRest, poutRest, t, N, A, B
                );

                vector<int> coefficients =
                    convolutionCoefficients(A, B, {s0});

                answer[y] = mulmod(cows[cm].ccw, coefficients[0]);
            }

            // At an endpoint, the corresponding floor decreases only
            // after the coordinate itself has been processed.
            if (cp >= 0) --h[cp];

            if (cm >= 0) {
                ++h[cm];
                bMod = (bMod + N - 1) % N;
            }

            if (cp != cm) {
                if (cp >= 0) {
                    updateHigh(cp, h[cp] == lowValue + 1);
                }
                if (cm >= 0) {
                    updateHigh(cm, h[cm] == lowValue + 1);
                }
            }

            pos = end;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            if (i) cout << ' ';
            cout << answer[i];
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static constexpr int MOD = 1'000'000'007;

class FastScanner {
    static constexpr int SIZE = 1 << 16;
    char buffer[SIZE];
    int pos = 0, len = 0;

    int getChar() {
        if (pos == len) {
            len = (int)fread(buffer, 1, SIZE, stdin);
            pos = 0;
            if (len == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buffer[pos++];
    }

public:
    template <class T>
    bool read(T &value) {
        int c;
        do {
            c = getChar();
            if (c == EOF) return false;
        } while (c <= ' ');

        bool negative = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            negative = true;
            c = getChar();
        }

        T result = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getChar();
        }

        value = negative ? -result : result;
        return true;
    }
};

class FastOutput {
    static constexpr int SIZE = 1 << 16;
    char buffer[SIZE];
    int pos = 0;

public:
    ~FastOutput() {
        flush();
    }

    void flush() {
        if (pos) {
            fwrite(buffer, 1, pos, stdout);
            pos = 0;
        }
    }

    void putChar(char c) {
        if (pos == SIZE) flush();
        buffer[pos++] = c;
    }

    void writeInt(int value, char after) {
        if (value == 0) {
            putChar('0');
        } else {
            char digits[12];
            int count = 0;
            while (value) {
                digits[count++] = char('0' + value % 10);
                value /= 10;
            }
            while (count) putChar(digits[--count]);
        }
        putChar(after);
    }
};

static int modPow(int base, int exponent) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long current = base;

    while (exponent) {
        if (exponent & 1) result = result * current % MOD;
        current = current * current % MOD;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)result;
}

static int oneMinus(int value) {
    int result = 1 - value;
    if (result < 0) result += MOD;
    return result;
}

/*
    Represents the polynomial a + b*z.

    If the relevant direction occurs with probability b, then:
      - coefficient a is the probability that it does not occur;
      - coefficient b*z is the probability that it occurs.
*/
struct Factor {
    int a, b;
    int inverseA;
    int ratio;  // b/a modulo MOD
};

static Factor makeFactor(int absent, int present) {
    Factor result;
    result.a = absent;
    result.b = present;

    if (result.a == 0) {
        result.inverseA = 0;
        result.ratio = 0;
    } else {
        result.inverseA = modPow(result.a, MOD - 2);
        result.ratio = (long long)result.b * result.inverseA % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

struct Polynomial {
    vector<int> coefficient;

    Polynomial() : coefficient(1, 1) {}
};

/* Multiply p by a + b*z. */
static void multiplyLinear(Polynomial &p, const Factor &f) {
    if (f.b == 0) return;

    int oldSize = (int)p.coefficient.size();
    p.coefficient.resize(oldSize + 1, 0);

    if (f.a == 0) {
        // The factor is z.
        for (int k = oldSize; k >= 1; --k) {
            p.coefficient[k] = p.coefficient[k - 1];
        }
        p.coefficient[0] = 0;
        return;
    }

    for (int k = oldSize; k >= 1; --k) {
        long long value =
            (long long)f.a * p.coefficient[k] +
            (long long)f.b * p.coefficient[k - 1];
        p.coefficient[k] = (int)(value % MOD);
    }
    p.coefficient[0] = (long long)f.a * p.coefficient[0] % MOD;
}

/*
    Divide p exactly by a + b*z.

    If p = (a+bz)h and a != 0, then
        h[k] = p[k]/a - (b/a)h[k-1].

    If a == 0, the factor is z, so division is a coefficient shift.
*/
static void divideLinear(Polynomial &p, const Factor &f) {
    if (f.b == 0) return;

    int oldSize = (int)p.coefficient.size();

    if (f.a == 0) {
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < oldSize; ++k) {
            p.coefficient[k] = p.coefficient[k + 1];
        }
        p.coefficient.resize(oldSize - 1);
        return;
    }

    p.coefficient[0] =
        (long long)p.coefficient[0] * f.inverseA % MOD;

    for (int k = 1; k + 1 < oldSize; ++k) {
        long long value =
            (long long)p.coefficient[k] * f.inverseA -
            (long long)f.ratio * p.coefficient[k - 1];
        value %= MOD;
        if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        p.coefficient[k] = (int)value;
    }

    p.coefficient.resize(oldSize - 1);
}

/*
    If clockwiseCandidate is true, candidate cow i is assumed to move
    clockwise. Relevant random variables are then "cow j moves CCW".

    Otherwise, candidate cow i is assumed to move counterclockwise, and
    relevant random variables are "cow j moves CW".
*/
static void processFamily(
    const vector<int> &x,
    const vector<int> &probability,
    int M,
    int kMod,
    long long q,
    int remaining,
    bool clockwiseCandidate,
    vector<int> &answer
) {
    const int N = (int)x.size();

    vector<Factor> factors(N);
    vector<int> ownProbability(N);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (clockwiseCandidate) {
            // Relevant event: cow moves counterclockwise.
            factors[i] = makeFactor(probability[i], oneMinus(probability[i]));
            ownProbability[i] = probability[i];
        } else {
            // Relevant event: cow moves clockwise.
            factors[i] = makeFactor(oneMinus(probability[i]), probability[i]);
            ownProbability[i] = oneMinus(probability[i]);
        }
    }

    const int qMod = (int)(q % N);
    const int qPlusOne = (qMod + 1) % N;

    Polynomial windowPolynomial;
    Polynomial complementPolynomial;
    vector<int> residueSum(N);

    auto evaluateCandidate = [&](int i) {
        if (ownProbability[i] == 0) return;

        // The complement currently contains candidate i. Remove its factor,
        // since its relevant direction is fixed to be absent.
        Polynomial outside = complementPolynomial;
        divideLinear(outside, factors[i]);

        fill(residueSum.begin(), residueSum.end(), 0);

        for (int outsideCount = 0;
             outsideCount < (int)outside.coefficient.size();
             ++outsideCount) {
            int residue =
                (long long)qMod * outsideCount % N;

            int value = residueSum[residue] + outside.coefficient[outsideCount];
            if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
            residueSum[residue] = value;
        }

        int target = clockwiseCandidate ? (N - i) % N : i % N;

        __int128 total = 0;

        for (int insideCount = 0;
             insideCount < (int)windowPolynomial.coefficient.size();
             ++insideCount) {
            int needed = (
                target - (long long)qPlusOne * insideCount
            ) % N;
            if (needed < 0) needed += N;

            total += (__int128)windowPolynomial.coefficient[insideCount]
                     * residueSum[needed];
        }

        int eventProbability = (int)(total % MOD);
        int contribution =
            (long long)eventProbability * ownProbability[i] % MOD;

        int position;
        if (clockwiseCandidate) {
            position = x[i] + kMod;
            if (position >= M) position -= M;
        } else {
            position = x[i] - kMod;
            if (position < 0) position += M;
        }

        answer[position] += contribution;
        if (answer[position] >= MOD) answer[position] -= MOD;
    };

    auto enterWindow = [&](int cow) {
        divideLinear(complementPolynomial, factors[cow]);
        multiplyLinear(windowPolynomial, factors[cow]);
    };

    auto leaveWindow = [&](int cow) {
        divideLinear(windowPolynomial, factors[cow]);
        multiplyLinear(complementPolynomial, factors[cow]);
    };

    if (clockwiseCandidate) {
        // Forward window: (x[i], x[i] + remaining], clockwise.
        vector<int> doubledPosition(2 * N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            doubledPosition[i] = x[i];
            doubledPosition[i + N] = x[i] + M;
        }

        int end = 0;
        while (end + 1 < 2 * N &&
               doubledPosition[end + 1] <= x[0] + remaining) {
            ++end;
        }

        for (int cow = 0; cow < N; ++cow) {
            if (cow >= 1 && cow <= end) {
                multiplyLinear(windowPolynomial, factors[cow]);
            } else {
                multiplyLinear(complementPolynomial, factors[cow]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            evaluateCandidate(i);

            if (i + 1 == N) break;

            int oldEnd = end;
            int newEnd = oldEnd;

            while (newEnd + 1 < 2 * N &&
                   doubledPosition[newEnd + 1] <= x[i + 1] + remaining) {
                ++newEnd;
            }

            // Cow i+1 is the new candidate and leaves the old window
            // if it was present.
            if (oldEnd >= i + 1) {
                leaveWindow((i + 1) % N);
            }

            // The new window starts after cow i+1.
            int firstEntering = max(oldEnd + 1, i + 2);
            for (int k = firstEntering; k <= newEnd; ++k) {
                enterWindow(k % N);
            }

            end = newEnd;
        }
    } else {
        // Backward window: [x[i] - remaining, x[i]), clockwise.
        auto extendedPosition = [&](int index) -> int {
            if (index < 0) return x[index + N] - M;
            return x[index];
        };

        int left = -N;
        while (left + 1 <= 0 &&
               extendedPosition(left + 1) < x[0] - remaining) {
            ++left;
        }

        for (int cow = 0; cow < N; ++cow) {
            bool inside =
                cow != 0 && x[cow] >= M - remaining;

            if (inside) {
                multiplyLinear(windowPolynomial, factors[cow]);
            } else {
                multiplyLinear(complementPolynomial, factors[cow]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            evaluateCandidate(i);

            if (i + 1 == N) break;

            int oldLeft = left;
            int newLeft = oldLeft;

            while (newLeft + 1 <= i + 1 &&
                   extendedPosition(newLeft + 1) < x[i + 1] - remaining) {
                ++newLeft;
            }

            // Cows leaving through the left boundary.
            for (int k = oldLeft; k < newLeft && k < i; ++k) {
                int cow = k % N;
                if (cow < 0) cow += N;
                leaveWindow(cow);
            }

            // Cow i enters through the new right boundary, if the window
            // is nonempty.
            if (newLeft <= i) {
                enterWindow(i);
            }

            left = newLeft;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    FastOutput output;

    int T;
    scanner.read(T);

    while (T--) {
        int N, M;
        long long K;
        scanner.read(N);
        scanner.read(M);
        scanner.read(K);

        vector<int> probability(N), x(N);
        for (int &value : probability) scanner.read(value);
        for (int &value : x) scanner.read(value);

        long long twiceK = 2LL * K;
        long long q = twiceK / M;
        int remaining = (int)(twiceK % M);
        int kMod = (int)(K % M);

        vector<int> answer(M, 0);

        processFamily(
            x, probability, M, kMod, q, remaining,
            true, answer
        );

        processFamily(
            x, probability, M, kMod, q, remaining,
            false, answer
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            output.writeInt(answer[i], i + 1 == M ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
